Interface Action

All Known Implementing Classes:
ApplyLoan, BrushTeeth, BuyPet, Cleaning, Deposit, EatMeal, EatSnack, Exercise, FeedPet, FeedPetMenu, GetCheckup, GroomPet, GroomPetMenu, Nap, PlayGame, PlayWithPet, PlayWithPetMenu, ReadBook, RepayLoan, Shower, ShowerPet, ShowerPetMenu, Sleep, SleepWithPet, SleepWithPetMenu, Socialise, UseToilet, WatchTV, Withdraw, Work
public interface Action
Interface for all in-game actions. Implements Command pattern: actions know all dependencies to execute themselves.
